# Section 1

```{r}
### Session 1: Variable Screening & Visualization

required_pkgs <- c("tidyverse", "pheatmap", "qvalue", "readxl")
for (pkg in required_pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pkg)
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

df <- read_excel("project data/CDCS data - Proteome Echo.xlsx")
protein_info <- read.delim("project data/CDCS protein info.txt")

train <- df %>% filter(Site == 1)
test <- df %>% filter(Site == 2)

train <- train %>% mutate(Outcome = ifelse(Outcome == "MACE", 1, 0))
test <- test %>% mutate(Outcome = ifelse(Outcome == "MACE", 1, 0))

variables <- colnames(train)[!(colnames(train) %in% c("StudyNo", "Outcome", "Site", "Age", "MACE"))]

#Age as predictor
model_age <- glm(Outcome ~ Age, data = train, family = binomial)
summary(model_age)

#Age-adjusted logistic regression
pvals_adj_age <- numeric(length(variables))
names(pvals_adj_age) <- variables

for (var in variables) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Outcome ~ Age +", var))
  fit <- try(glm(formula, data = train, family = binomial), silent = TRUE)
  
  if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    coef_summary <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    if (nrow(coef_summary) > 2) {
      pvals_adj_age[var] <- coef_summary[3, 4]
    } else {
      pvals_adj_age[var] <- NA
    }
  } else {
    pvals_adj_age[var] <- NA
  }
}

hist(na.omit(pvals_adj_age), breaks = 100,
     main = "Adjusted p-values (Age + Variable)",
     xlab = "p-value", col = "skyblue")


#Unadjusted logistic regression
pvals_unadjusted <- numeric(length(variables))
names(pvals_unadjusted) <- variables

for (var in variables) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste("Outcome ~", var))
  fit <- try(glm(formula, data = train, family = binomial), silent = TRUE)
  
  if (!inherits(fit, "try-error")) {
    coef_summary <- summary(fit)$coefficients
    if (nrow(coef_summary) > 1) {
      pvals_unadjusted[var] <- coef_summary[2, 4]
    } else {
      pvals_unadjusted[var] <- NA
    }
  } else {
    pvals_unadjusted[var] <- NA
  }
}

hist(na.omit(pvals_unadjusted), breaks = 100,
     main = "Unadjusted p-values (Variable only)",
     xlab = "p-value", col = "salmon")

#q-value threshold and heatmap visualization
qvals <- qvalue(na.omit(pvals_unadjusted))$qvalues
selected_vars <- names(qvals)[qvals < 0.3]

train_selected <- train %>% select(all_of(selected_vars))
test_selected <- test %>% select(all_of(selected_vars))

cor_train <- cor(train_selected, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cor_test <- cor(test_selected, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")

cat("\n🔵 Blue: Strong Negative Correlation (-1)\n⚪ White: No Correlation (0)\n🔴 Red: Strong Positive Correlation (+1)")

pheatmap(cor_train,
         main = "Training Set Correlation Heatmap",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         legend = TRUE,
         legend_breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5),
         legend_labels = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5))

pheatmap(cor_test,
         main = "Test Set Correlation Heatmap",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
         legend = TRUE,
         legend_breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5),
         legend_labels = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5))




```

# Section 2

```{r}
#Regularized Logistic Regression

required_pkgs <- c("glmnet", "grpreg", "pROC", "dplyr", "VennDiagram")
for (pkg in required_pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pkg)
  library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
}

# Mapping variables and constructing matrix
selected_info <- protein_info %>% filter(SomaId %in% selected_vars)
selected_ids <- selected_info$SomaId
selected_groups <- selected_info$Target

X_train <- as.matrix(dplyr::select(train, all_of(selected_ids)))
X_test <- as.matrix(dplyr::select(test, all_of(selected_ids)))
y_train <- train$Outcome
y_test <- test$Outcome

if (ncol(X_train) < 2) stop("X_train has less than 2 columns. Cannot run glmnet.")

#LASSO
lasso_model <- cv.glmnet(X_train, y_train, family = "binomial", alpha = 1)
lasso_lambda <- lasso_model$lambda.min
lasso_coef <- coef(lasso_model, s = lasso_lambda)
lasso_selected_vars <- rownames(lasso_coef)[which(lasso_coef != 0)][-1]

lasso_targets <- protein_info %>% 
  filter(SomaId %in% lasso_selected_vars) %>%
  dplyr::select(SomaId, Target)

cat("LASSO selected", nrow(lasso_targets), "variables\n")
print(lasso_targets)

lasso_pred <- as.vector(predict(lasso_model, newx = X_test, type = "response", s = lasso_lambda))

#Elastic Net
elastic_model <- cv.glmnet(X_train, y_train, family = "binomial", alpha = 0.5)
elastic_lambda <- elastic_model$lambda.min
elastic_coef <- coef(elastic_model, s = elastic_lambda)
elastic_selected_vars <- rownames(elastic_coef)[which(elastic_coef != 0)][-1]

elastic_targets <- protein_info %>% 
  filter(SomaId %in% elastic_selected_vars) %>%
  dplyr::select(SomaId, Target)

cat("\nElastic Net selected", nrow(elastic_targets), "variables\n")
print(elastic_targets)

elastic_pred <- as.vector(predict(elastic_model, newx = X_test, type = "response", s = elastic_lambda))

#Group LASSO
ordered_info <- selected_info %>% filter(SomaId %in% colnames(X_train))
X_train_group <- X_train[, ordered_info$SomaId]
X_test_group <- X_test[, ordered_info$SomaId]

group_labels <- match(ordered_info$Target, unique(ordered_info$Target))

group_lasso_model <- grpreg(X_train_group, y_train, group = group_labels, family = "binomial")
group_lasso_selected <- grpreg::select(group_lasso_model, criterion = "BIC")
group_lambda <- group_lasso_selected$lambda
group_coef <- group_lasso_selected$beta
group_selected_vars <- colnames(X_train_group)[which(group_coef[-1] != 0)]

group_targets <- protein_info %>% 
  filter(SomaId %in% group_selected_vars) %>%
  dplyr::select(SomaId, Target)

cat("\nGroup LASSO selected", nrow(group_targets), "variables\n")
print(group_targets)

group_pred <- as.vector(predict(group_lasso_model, X = X_test_group, type = "response", lambda = group_lambda))

#AUC comparison
lasso_auc <- auc(y_test, lasso_pred)
elastic_auc <- auc(y_test, elastic_pred)
group_auc <- auc(y_test, group_pred)

cat("\nAUC Comparison:\n")
cat(sprintf("LASSO AUC:        %.3f\n", lasso_auc))
cat(sprintf("Elastic Net AUC:  %.3f\n", elastic_auc))
cat(sprintf("Group LASSO AUC:  %.3f\n", group_auc))

plot.roc(y_test, lasso_pred, col = "blue", main = "ROC Curve Comparison", lwd = 2)
lines.roc(y_test, elastic_pred, col = "orange", lwd = 2)
lines.roc(y_test, group_pred, col = "darkgreen", lwd = 2)
legend("bottomright", legend = c("LASSO", "Elastic Net", "Group LASSO"),
       col = c("blue", "orange", "darkgreen"), lwd = 2)

#Variable overlap + discussion
intersect_vars <- Reduce(intersect, list(lasso_selected_vars, elastic_selected_vars, group_selected_vars))
intersect_targets <- protein_info %>%
  filter(SomaId %in% intersect_vars) %>%
  dplyr::select(SomaId, Target)

cat("\nVariables selected by all three models:", nrow(intersect_targets), "\n")
print(intersect_targets)


venn.plot <- venn.diagram(
  x = list(
    LASSO = lasso_selected_vars,
    ElasticNet = elastic_selected_vars,
    GroupLASSO = group_selected_vars
  ),
  category.names = c("LASSO", "Elastic Net", "Group LASSO"),
  filename = NULL,
  output = TRUE,
  fill = c("cornflowerblue", "darkorange", "seagreen"),
  alpha = 0.5,
  cex = 1.2,
  cat.cex = 1.2,
  cat.fontface = "bold",
  main = "Variable Overlap Across Models"
)

grid.newpage()
grid.draw(venn.plot)


```

# Section 3

```{r}
### Session 3: Model Integration and Performance Enhancement

#Train Random Forest model
if (!requireNamespace("randomForest", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("randomForest")
library(randomForest)

set.seed(42)
rf_model <- randomForest(x = X_train, y = as.factor(y_train), ntree = 500, mtry = sqrt(ncol(X_train)))
rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, newdata = X_test, type = "prob")[, 2]
rf_auc <- auc(y_test, rf_pred)
cat("Random Forest AUC:", round(rf_auc, 3), "\n")

#Train Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) model
if (!requireNamespace("gbm", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("gbm")
library(gbm)

set.seed(42)
gbm_model <- gbm(Outcome ~ ., data = data.frame(Outcome = y_train, X_train),
                 distribution = "bernoulli", n.trees = 3000, interaction.depth = 3,
                 shrinkage = 0.01, cv.folds = 5, verbose = FALSE)

best_iter <- gbm.perf(gbm_model, method = "cv", plot.it = FALSE)
gbm_pred <- predict(gbm_model, newdata = data.frame(X_test), n.trees = best_iter, type = "response")
gbm_auc <- auc(y_test, gbm_pred)
cat("GBM AUC:          ", round(gbm_auc, 3), "\n")

#Compare Top 20 Features from RF, GBM, and Elastic Net
top_rf <- names(sort(rf_model$importance[, 1], decreasing = TRUE))[1:20]
gbm_summary <- summary(gbm_model, plotit = FALSE)
top_gbm <- gbm_summary$var[1:20]
top_elastic <- elastic_selected_vars[1:min(20, length(elastic_selected_vars))]

cat("\nTop 20 RF variables:\n")
print(top_rf)

cat("\nTop 20 GBM variables:\n")
print(top_gbm)

cat("\nTop 20 Elastic Net variables:\n")
print(top_elastic)


```

```{r}
### Session 4
required_pkgs <- c("VennDiagram", "UpSetR", "pROC", "knitr")
for (pkg in required_pkgs) {
  if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) install.packages(pkg)

plot.roc(y_test, lasso_pred, col = "blue", lwd = 2, main = "ROC Curve: All 5 Models")

       legend = c("LASSO", "Elastic Net", "Group LASSO", "Random Forest", "GBM"),
       col = c("blue", "orange", "darkgreen", "purple", "brown"),
       lwd = 2)

cat("\n--- Final AUC Summary ---\n")
cat(sprintf("LASSO AUC:         %.3f\n", lasso_auc))
cat(sprintf("Elastic Net AUC:   %.3f\n", elastic_auc))
cat(sprintf("Group LASSO AUC:   %.3f\n", group_auc))
cat(sprintf("Random Forest AUC: %.3f\n", rf_auc))
cat(sprintf("GBM AUC:           %.3f\n", gbm_auc))


cat("\nLASSO selected:", length(lasso_selected_vars), "variables\n")
cat("Elastic Net selected:", length(elastic_selected_vars), "variables\n")
cat("Group LASSO selected:", length(group_selected_vars), "variables\n")

lasso_set <- unique(lasso_selected_vars)
elastic_set <- unique(elastic_selected_vars)
group_set <- unique(group_selected_vars)

intersect_all <- Reduce(intersect, list(lasso_set, elastic_set, group_set))
cat("Variables selected by all 3 models:", length(intersect_all), "\n")

venn.plot <- VennDiagram::venn.diagram(
  x = list(
    LASSO = lasso_set,
    ElasticNet = elastic_set,
    GroupLASSO = group_set
  ),
  category.names = c("LASSO", "Elastic Net", "Group LASSO"),
  filename = NULL,
  output = TRUE,
  fill = c("cornflowerblue", "darkorange", "seagreen"),
  alpha = 0.5,
  cex = 1.2,
  cat.cex = 1.2,
  cat.fontface = "bold",
  main = "Variable Overlap Across Models"
)
grid.newpage()
grid.draw(venn.plot)

all_vars <- unique(c(lasso_set, elastic_set, group_set))
upset_df <- data.frame(
  Variable = all_vars,
  LASSO = all_vars %in% lasso_set,
  ElasticNet = all_vars %in% elastic_set,
  GroupLASSO = all_vars %in% group_set
)

UpSetR::upset(
  fromList(list(
    LASSO = lasso_set,
    ElasticNet = elastic_set,
    GroupLASSO = group_set
  )),
  main.bar.color = "steelblue",
  sets.bar.color = "grey40",
  order.by = "freq"
)

cat("\nGroup LASSO selected", length(group_selected_vars), "variables:\n")
kable(group_targets)

```
